messages:
vivian: I opened a docs PR to update the Peregrine-13b model card (https://git.redwood/workspace/docs/pull/943). Found a few inconsistent bits: the Python snippet still uses old client imports, the limits table claims 20k tokens but our perf run is stable to ~16k, the bench permalink 404s, and there's no guidance for embedding sharding across long contexts. Can someone pick items?
harry: I'll take the Python examples. Which import is wrong?
vivian: It currently has `from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient` and `client = RedwoodClient()`  should be `from redwood import Client` and `client = Client()` per SDK v3. Also include a short streaming example and a note about prefix/KV caching.
jules: I'll handle the limits + bench validation. Which perf path?
vivian: s3://redwood-bench/peregrine-13b/2026-11/perf.csv. The GPU mem graph shows instability beyond 16,000 tokens. Upstream model metadata lists 20,480 which wasn't validated. I propose wording: "tested max (tokens): 16,000; catalog ceiling: 20,480 (untested beyond tested max)".
harry: For the Python streaming snippet I'll add both sync and stream patterns and a minimal KV-caching hint. Draft streaming snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.text.stream(model="peregrine-13b") as s:
    s.append("Summarize the document:")
    for chunk in s.recv_stream():
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```
jules: I replaced the broken bench link with the bench index and added the s3 path in the card (https://bench.redwood/internal/index and s3://redwood-bench/peregrine-13b/2026-11/). Note in the PR that the index is internal-only; include raw s3 location for reproducibility.
vivian: Also add an embedding-sharding recipe: split long contexts into N <=8k token chunks, compute embedding per-chunk, aggregate by concatenation with metadata. Add short TS+Python examples.
harry: Good call. I'll add a tiny helper in the TS snippet for parallel shard requests and batch sizes (256-512) to avoid OOMs.
jules: Also add a compatibility bullet: "Quant variants: q4f16 tested on Dedicated/Private; hosted offers q4a for lower-latency paths. CPU fallback may occur for q4f16 with very long contexts."
docs-ci: preview built: https://staging.docs.redwood/pr-943  preview will update on new commits.
vivian: QA checklist in PR: confirm staging renders, run snippet smoke tests with @redwood/sdk@3.6.0, verify bench link resolves for internal users, and update supported-variants table to include peregrine-13b-lite (reduced throughput).
harry: Pushed snippet commits and the KV caching note. Left a TODO to add a small note about cache TTL for prefix caches.
jules: Limits table updated and footnote added with s3 path. Added the tested vs ceiling wording.
vivian: Final: once commits land I'll request review. If no blockers by EOD I'll merge. Thanks all :rocket:
